import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(column, data):
    if not data:
        raise ValueError("data list is empty")

    df = pd.DataFrame(data)

    if column not in df.columns:
        raise KeyError(column)

    required_columns = ["steps", "calories burned", "distance walked", "Date"]
    missing_columns = [col for col in required_columns if col not in df.columns]
    if missing_columns:
        raise KeyError(f"Missing required columns: {missing_columns}")

    for col in ["steps", "calories burned", "distance walked"]:
        numeric_values = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="raise")
        if (numeric_values < 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"Negative values found in {col}")

    target = pd.to_numeric(df[column], errors="raise")

    stats = {
        "sum": float(target.sum()),
        "mean": float(target.mean()),
        "min": float(target.min()),
        "max": float(target.max()),
    }

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.plot(df["Date"], target)
    ax.set_xlabel("Date")
    ax.set_ylabel(column)
    ax.set_title(f"Line Chart of ({column})")

    return stats, ax
